items.name: HL · 8 p.m. tomorrow run
items.what: The 2.3 solved problem: every evening at 20:00, Search Rows finds tomorrow's orders, a Not cancelled filter drops cancelled ones, and a router with additive routes puts deliverable orders on the rider list, emails unpaid customers a payment reminder, alerts Tolu on Telegram about orders over ₦50,000, and logs anything that matched nothing to Needs checking. The six test rows cost 8 credits.
build: 1 · Google Sheets › Search Rows: business Google connection; Spreadsheet = Harvest Lane; Sheet = Orders; Table contains headers = Yes; Filter = delivery_date (column E) Equal to {{formatDate(addDays(now; 1); "YYYY-MM-DD")}}; Limit = 100.
Filter on 1→2, label Not cancelled: status · Text operators: Not equal to (case insensitive) · Cancelled.
2 · Flow control › Router with four routes, in this order:
Filter on 2→3, label Rider list · Paid or standing: status Equal to (case insensitive) Paid, OR (new OR group) channel Equal to (case insensitive) standing.

3 · Google Sheets › Add a Row: Sheet = Deliveries; A delivery_date = {{1.delivery_date}}; B order_id = {{1.order_id}}; C customer_name = {{1.customer_name}}; D phone = {{1.phone}}; E delivery_window = {{1.delivery_window}}; F total = {{1.total}}; G status = {{1.status}}; H channel = {{1.channel}}.
Filter on 2→4, label Reminder · New and not standing: status Equal to (case insensitive) New AND channel Not equal to (case insensitive) standing.

4 · Gmail › Send an Email: To = {{1.customer_email}}; Subject = Harvest Lane · please pay for order {{1.order_id}}; Content = Hi {{1.customer_name}}, your Harvest Lane order {{1.order_id}} is due for delivery tomorrow. Total: ₦{{formatNumber(1.total; 0; "."; ",")}}. Please pay here so we can put it on the rider list: {{1.payment_link}}. Thank you!
Filter on 2→5, label Big order · total > 50000: total · Numeric operators: Greater than · 50000 (numeric, not text).

5 · Telegram Bot › Send a Text Message or a Reply: Chat ID = YOUR_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID (Tolu's chat); Text = Big order tomorrow: {{1.order_id}} · {{1.customer_name}} · ₦{{formatNumber(1.total; 0; "."; ",")}} · status {{1.status}} · channel {{1.channel}}. (Or use Gmail › Send an Email to Tolu instead.)

Route 4 → 6, label Fallback · Needs checking: right-click the link and tick Fallback route. The blueprint also carries the equivalent explicit rule: status Not equal to Paid AND channel Not equal to standing AND status Not equal to New AND total Less than or equal to 50000 (all text operators case insensitive).

6 · Google Sheets › Add a Row: Sheet = Needs checking; A noted_at = {{formatDate(now; "YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm")}}; B order_id = {{1.order_id}}; C customer_name = {{1.customer_name}}; D status = {{1.status}}; E channel = {{1.channel}}; F total = {{1.total}}; G reason = Matched no route.
Scenario settings › Schedule: Every day at 20:00. Scheduling ON. Scenario name: HL · 8 p.m. tomorrow run.
setup: In Make, set your organisation and profile time zone to Africa/Lagos before running anything with dates (2.2).

Orders tab layout the blueprints assume (row 1 = headers): A order_id, B created_at, C customer_id, D customer_name, E delivery_date, F delivery_fee, G status, H items_total, I total (the 0.4 columns), then J phone, K channel, L delivery_window, M customer_email, N payment_link. If your columns differ, open each Google Sheets module after import and re-pick the columns; the build list names every field.

Add two tabs: Deliveries (delivery_date, order_id, customer_name, phone, delivery_window, total, status, channel) and Needs checking (noted_at, order_id, customer_name, status, channel, total, reason). Make status a dropdown (Paid, New, Cancelled, On hold) as in 0.4.

Create a Telegram bot with BotFather, send it a message from Tolu's account, and put that chat's ID where the blueprint says YOUR_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID. Never paste the bot token anywhere except Make's connection screen.
In Make: Scenarios → Create a new scenario → the three-dot menu at the bottom → Import Blueprint → choose this file.
Create connections: Google Sheets (modules 1, 3, 6) and Gmail (module 4) with the business Google account; Telegram Bot (module 5) with the bot token.
Open module 1 and confirm the filter column is delivery_date. Open the link into route 6 and set it as the Fallback route.
Schedule: every day at 20:00, then switch scheduling ON.
items.test: Put the six truth-table rows in Orders with tomorrow's date: T1 Paid/whatsapp/26500, T2 New/form/13500, T3 New/whatsapp/82000, T4 New/standing/95000, T5 On hold/form/9000, T6 Cancelled/whatsapp/40000. Run once. Expected bubble counts: Deliveries 2 (T1, T4), Reminder 2 (T2, T3), Alert 2 (T3, T4), Needs checking 1 (T5); T6 stops at the Not cancelled filter and nothing appears twice on Deliveries. Credits: 1 search + 7 actions = 8.

walk.title: Build it: the 8 p.m. tomorrow run
walk.sample: Six orders for tomorrow · T1 Paid 26,500 · T2 New 13,500 · T3 New 82,000 · T4 standing 95,000 · T5 On hold · T6 Cancelled

steps.say: We start with a search, not a watch. Search Rows finds every order whose delivery date is tomorrow, one bundle per order.
show: Google Sheets › Search Rows · Sheet: Orders

steps.say: It runs once a day at eight in the evening. One search a night is far cheaper than polling every fifteen minutes.
On the link before the router we drop cancelled orders. Filters cost nothing, and junk stops here before any work is done.
show: status · Not equal to (case insensitive) · Cancelled

steps.say: Now the router. Write each route's rule in words first. These routes are additive: one order can take two routes when it needs two jobs.
show: 1 Rider list · 2 Reminder · 3 Big order · Fallback

steps.say: Route one, the rider list: every order that will be delivered. Paid, or a standing customer, so it's an OR group.
Those orders become a row on the Deliveries tab, with what the rider needs: name, phone and delivery window.
show: Google Sheets › Add a Row · Sheet: Deliveries

steps.say: Route two, reminders: new orders that aren't standing customers. Both conditions must be true, so they sit in one AND group.
The customer gets a polite email with their total and the payment link, so they can pay before the riders go out.
show: Subject: Harvest Lane · please pay for order {{1.order_id}}

steps.say: Route three alerts Tolu about any order over fifty thousand naira. Use the numeric operator here. A text comparison would let a nine thousand naira order through.
The alert goes to Tolu on Telegram. The bot token lives only in Make's connection screen, never in a message or a sheet.
show: Telegram Bot › Send a Text Message

steps.say: The last route is the fallback. Mark it as fallback, and anything that matched no rule lands in Needs checking instead of vanishing.
show: Add a Row · Sheet: Needs checking

steps.say: Remember, routes never merge back. Anything every order needs, like a log, belongs before the router.
Run once with the six test rows and read the counts: two, two, two and one. That's one credit for the search and seven for the work. The filter and router are free.
steps.data: nothing twice on the rider list

walk.end: Load the six truth-table rows with tomorrow's date, run once, and check every bubble count against the expected routes.
